$comment: Herald seat permission profile. APPLIED 2026-08-05 by edict into the CIVILIZATION LAYER (civ/), not Manyhalls: the Herald was always civ-scope, his only input being the civilization digest across all forts. Paths repointed from fort/ to civ/ per docs/proposals/herald-founding/CIV-LAYER-SUPERSESSION.md. Publishing is covenant gate 6.1, unamendable. Modeled on warden-settings.json; loaded by civ/scripts/herald.sh with --setting-sources '' so this file is the ONLY permission source. Layering: this profile is policy, the kernel mask is the boundary. Verified caveat, same as every profile here: absent commands are not reliably denied, and deny rules bind a command SPELLING rather than a file (ForgeOs-21f.8, measured six-for-six). Treat allow as convenience, deny as intent, the mask as the boundary. The Herald reads the digest and writes prose; he has no reason to touch git, npm, or bd mutations, so all are denied. The fort/ deny rules are retained deliberately: he may not write a settlement's constitution either.
